description: The Hellenic Statistical Authority publishes 17 tables from its 2021 Buildings Census, the building count that precedes the Population and Housing Census, with every table broken down from the whole country through regions, regional units, municipalities and communities to individual settlements, about 21,200 geographic rows with official codes. The tables count buildings by number of floors and basements, use and mixed use, number of dwellings, construction period, main frame material, roof type and covering, adjoining buildings, lifts and step free access. Coverage is all of Greece: 4,285,084 buildings, of which 2,596,725 have a concrete frame, 821,921 brick or block, 726,536 stone, 56,434 metal and 21,320 wood. Format and access: free XLSX downloads on the Greek tables page, no registration; the English page lists no files. Licence: ELSTAT copyright and reuse terms, published as a document that did not load from the cloud. Caveats: labels are in Greek only; building counts, not footprints or floor areas. Simulation uses: settlement level seismic and flood exposure by frame material, height and age, and building stock models for energy retrofit. Related records: EUBUCCO European building footprints and the INVERT EU27 residential building stock scenarios.
